title: The Pagination Bug
description: Transaction pages omit records from bulk imports and return unstable ordering.
objective: Reproduce the reported failures and repair the implementation without changing its public interfaces.
expectedBehavior: list_transactions takes a list of dicts with integer id, account_id, and aware created_at. Return data, has_more, next_cursor. Sort created_at DESC then id DESC, preserving microseconds and UTC instants. Cursors must preserve both keys. Never skip or duplicate account records. Limits are integers 1–100; malformed cursors raise ValueError. Cursor helpers may change to support composite keys.
constraints: Use only the language standard library; no network access or external packages.
The provided tests are read-only; additional private tests verify edge cases.
